answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 23172 Country: United States of America Title: I painted a building and had paint on my hands for a while, im not sure if i hadit on for more then one day ,but i was positive that i had it on for more then 1 day there forer i made up a days worth of salahj in which i was sure paint was still on my hands, should i make up and additional day or two because i dont remember if i removed it after that or was my making up one day sufficient? Question: I painted a building and had paint on my hands for a while, im not sure if i hadit on for more then one day ,but i was positive that i had it on for more then 1 day there forer i made up a days worth of salahj in which i was sure paint was still on my hands, should i make up and additional day or two because i dont remember if i removed it after that or was my making up one day sufficient? Answer ID: 23172 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1271/957/H=1431) Calculate the days in which the paint remained in your hands and re-offer the salah of those days. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
